# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 43 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** The Serpent and the Fall Recounted

---

**1** 'The serpent came to me and said cunningly: "Why do you not eat of the tree in the middle of the garden? God knows that when you eat of it, your eyes will be opened."'

**2** 'I was deceived by the serpent's words and ate of the tree. I also gave some to your father, and he ate.'

**3** 'Immediately our eyes were opened and we knew we were naked, and we were ashamed.'

---
*LOGOS: formal equivalence; verse-only numbering.*
